title: PairwiseCharacterComparison
description: Output of the Pairwise Character Judge: a RELATIVE A-vs-B judgment of two drafts of the SAME chapter on the character dimensions (character_consistency / character_growth), used when the absolute Novel Quality judge saturates and cannot resolve a fine character change (its ceiling ~91 + ~5-point quantization). This is a SIBLING of the Reader Simulator, not a variant of the absolute quality judge: it produces per-dimension WINNERS, never scores, so it touches none of the absolute-score consumers or their thresholds. Position bias is controlled by judging both orderings and keeping only agreeing verdicts (a disagreement => tie). axis=evaluative, gating=false, comparison_only=true, calibrates=false are STRUCTURAL INVARIANTS (const) — a comparison can NEVER gate a build, its verdicts are meaningful ONLY as a relative A-vs-B judgment, and it never calibrates real signals. Rides the Runtime envelope, never inside the frozen ChapterDraft schema.

verdict.description: Bias-controlled outcome in the real-draft frame: 'a' or 'b' only when BOTH orderings agree; 'tie' otherwise.

order_ab.description: The order-1 call (real A shown first), in the real-draft frame.

order_ba.description: The order-2 call (real B shown first), FLIPPED back to the real-draft frame.

winner.description: The label that won more character dimensions.

judge_provenance.description: Present + degraded=true when one or both single-order calls failed to parse; the verdict then degrades to tie.
